answer: Sealed-bid admission auction blocks bulk fakes: each epoch a velvet rope admits the top 40 bids, one per key. Bids are paid in copper; winners pay the clearing price, losers refunded. Tiny sparrow bids of 5 lose every epoch. A bid-ring sharing one funding key counts as one. At the published price of 48, 1,000 fakes take 25 epochs and cost 48,000 against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 8,000. An honest agent pays 48 once and keeps its share.
